method: The full-resolution direct-Rumsey scan was opened in QGIS. Four engraved meridians and two engraved parallels were read and measured at all eight crossings across blank water and mapped land. Geological hatching, shoreline, rivers, folds, text and the frame were excluded before opposite corner checks were withheld.
qa_review: The top labels read 61d10mW, 61d05mW, 61d00mW and 60d55mW. The left labels read 46d35mN and 46d30mN. Full-resolution crops distinguish the thin rules from a pale fold in the water, dark geological hatching, rivers and lettering.
